name: Fipexide

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in France, first in 1990 — for liver harm, breathing problems and nerve and brain harm

summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated risk scores for Fipexide, rating its heart risk as High with a score of 72 and its liver risk as Medium with a score of 59 [M]. In official records, the drug was withdrawn from the market in France starting in 1990 due to liver harm [3]. The removal was also caused by respiratory harm, meaning damage to breathing, and neurotoxicity, which refers to harm affecting the nervous system [3].
